category_fits.label: Technology & Innovation
category_fits.why_fit: The report surveys major technology shifts and forecasts, including smart speakers and digital assistants, VR/AR, and technology and media revenues. Its Reality Computing section explicitly considers immersive technology as a broader computing platform.
category_fits.why_not_fit: It also covers media markets, consumer attention, and other trends, so not every section is about technology innovation.

category_fits.label: Consumer Behavior & Insights
category_fits.why_fit: Dedicated sections analyze how consumers allocate media attention and how high-attention users account for disproportionate shares of video and audio time and spending; the report also draws on consumer research.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Consumer behavior is one important strand within a wider technology and media outlook, rather than the report's sole organizing lens.

category_fits.label: Business Performance & Growth
category_fits.why_fit: The opening section forecasts $302 billion of global consumer Internet and media revenue growth from 2017E to 2021E and compares growth rates.
category_fits.why_not_fit: Those commercial forecasts are one part of a broad technology and media trends outlook, not the report's dominant performance-decision lens.
